name: octaweave_create_card
description: Add a card to a board column. `column` is a column id or its name. `after` places the card directly below that card id — omit it to append to the bottom. `labels` are names and unknown ones are created. `due_at` is RFC-3339.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

after.description: Optional card id to insert below; omit to append.
